column3: NASB renders “bearing witness with me” as “bearing me witness.”
Close to the Greek.
NASB renders “I was wishing” as “I could wish,” “a curse” as “accursed,” and “brothers” as “brethren.”
NASB renders “the lawgiving” as “the giving of the Law” and “the service” as “the temple service.”
NASB renders “patriarchs” as “fathers” and “to the ages” as “forever”; its punctuation reads “God blessed forever” as said of Christ.
NASB renders “who are of Israel” as “who are descended from Israel.”
NASB renders “seed” and “offspring” as “descendants”; the quotation is in capitals. A full-width colon appears in the NASB text.
NASB renders “offspring” as “descendants.”
The quotation is in capitals. A full-width colon appears in the NASB text.
NASB adds “there was” and “twins” and renders “by one conception” as “when she had conceived … by one man.”
NASB moves “not because of works, but because of Him who calls,” which opens v. 12 in the Greek, into this verse; it adds “twins” and renders “election” as “choice.”
NASB begins after the words moved to v. 11; the quotation is in capitals.
The quotation is in capitals.
NASB casts the question as “There is no injustice with God, is there?” and renders “Never would it be” as “May it never be.”
The quotation is in capitals.
NASB adds “does not depend on” and “the man.”
The quotation is in capitals; “show” is rendered “DEMONSTRATE.”
NASB renders “wants” as “desires.”
NASB renders “purpose” as “will.”
NASB renders “but rather” as “On the contrary” and “the thing formed” as “the thing molded,” and it adds “will it?”
NASB renders “authority” as “a right,” “unto honor” as “for honorable use,” and “unto dishonor” as “for common use.”
NASB adds “although” and renders “bore” as “endured” and “fitted” as “prepared.”
NASB adds “And He did so.”

The quotation is in capitals; “Hosts” is transliterated “SABAOTH.”
